values.eml_summary: If the semantic middle layer N_μ has no measurement value, then adding it should not improve the explanation or prediction of cross-architecture efficiency, error paths, scaffold gain or task transfer over a direct physical-cost → quality model. μI itself must pass this predictive/explanatory utility test or be revised or eliminated.
values.eml_summary_zh: 若語意中間層 N_μ 沒有測量價值，那麼加入它不應比直接的「物理成本 → 品質」模型更能解釋或預測跨架構效率、錯誤路徑、鷹架增益或任務遷移。μI 本身必須通過這個預測／解釋效用檢驗，否則就該被修正或淘汰。
eml_falsification_conditions: Falsified if N_μ adds no explanatory or predictive power over physical-cost → quality models; supported if it does.
